messages:
mei: Heads-up — we're seeing intermittent TLS handshakes spike (~300-800ms) between eu-west ingress -> apac backend since the key rotation last night. Not constant, ~1-2% of requests.
jon: saw the alert. Any correlation with KMS denies or RBAC changes?
sam: quick peek at edge logs: a few `tls_handshake_failed` with `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` and some with `tls: handshake did not complete`.
priya: audit logs show a handful of `kms.decrypt` DENY around 03:12 UTC for service-account `svc-ingress-proxy@redwood-prod`. There's also a policy push at 03:10 from infra-team.
irina: could be rotator pushed a new intermediate cert or updated keystore perms. `sec-rotator-bot` ran a few jobs last night.
sec-rotator-bot: rotator job 2026-03-19T03:09Z completed for eu-west; uploaded new cert version v5, rotated secret `ingress-cert` in ns `edge`.
mei: okay—possible race where some nodes got new cert but backend pods still have older trust bundles, causing occasional chain validation/timeouts.
jon: also saw increased `session_ticket` churn in proxy metrics. If session ticket keys were rotated without synchronized ticket key sharing, handshakes fall back to full handshake and kv-cache misses.
sam: running repro: `openssl s_client -connect backend.apac.internal:443 -servername backend.apac.internal -showcerts` returns full chain mostly, but intermittently the intermediate is missing. Pasting snippet:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=backend.apac.internal
   i:/CN=redwood-intermediate-v5
 1 s:/CN=redwood-intermediate-v5
   i:/CN=redwood-root
---
```
and some runs return only leaf cert.
priya: audit query: `resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" severity>=ERROR` shows 7 denies in eu-west region same window. Looks like IAM binding for rotator role was tightened in that push.
irina: action items: 1) validate keystore versions across clusters, 2) confirm rotator had KMS decrypt rights for new key ARN, 3) re-run rotator job with dry-run to surface missing intermediates, 4) temporarily enable proxy fallback to serve partial cert chain? (probably unsafe).
jon: RACI: jon -> KMS IAM check and policy rollback if needed; sam -> packet capture and openssl probe across nodes; priya -> audit log timeline + who pushed infra PR; mei -> coordinate deploy and incident comms; irina -> rotator re-run and keystore consistency.
sam: running `tcpdump -w /tmp/handshake.pcap port 443 and host backend.apac.internal` on an affected node now. Also will collect Envoy debug: `curl -s localhost:9901/logging?level=debug`.
priya: infra PR #4221 is the change at 03:08 that tightened `roles/kms.decrypt` on `group:infra-rotators`. tagging @infra for immediate revert possibility.
mei: if revert needed, prefer targeted IAM rebinding for `svc-ingress-proxy` instead of full rollback. Keep me posted.
john: (typo) — ignore
irina: re-run plan: `sec-rotator-bot reapply --namespace edge --keystore ingress-cert --mode dry-run && sec-rotator-bot reapply --namespace edge --keystore ingress-cert --force` once IAM confirmed. Will log steps.
sec-rotator-bot: acknowledged. will not run force until `iam-ok` flag present.
sam: pcap shows TLS handshake where server sends only leaf cert in 2/50 captures. That matches openssl runs. Also saw increased RTT on TCP connect for the same flows.
jon: KMS policy check: the key had a conditional that excluded service accounts without `project:infra` label; during rotation svc account used ephemeral identity and got excluded. Filing quick revert: re-add binding and run `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding` patch.
priya: adding notes to audit ticket and tagging legal/compliance since certchain spikes could trigger client-side retries and expose PII in logs.
mei: temporary mitigation: enable proxy config `accept_partial_chain: true` in eu-west for 30m and add rate limit to reduce retry amplification. Then fix keystore. Any objections?
jon: ok for 30m with close monitoring. Make sure we record change in changelog and toggle.
irina: starting rotator dry-run now. will report output in 10m.
priya: posting timeline and evidence to incident board: https://redwood.incidents/IN-2026-0319-tls-chain
mei: thanks everyone. please add small comments here as you complete tasks. We'll do a postmortem once root cause fully confirmed. :thumbsup:
